text.title: WCAG 2.2 Compliance Failure Modes
text.summary: 6 antipatterns observed in real deployments. Each pairs symptom + root cause + concrete fix.

antipattern.symptom: Audit covers 4 of 9 new SC; conformance claim made anyway.
antipattern.fix: Validator rejects sc_results missing any of the 9; full coverage required.

antipattern.symptom: Sticky header clips focus ring on form field at 1.4x zoom.
antipattern.root-cause: Sticky positioning not tested under focus + zoom.
antipattern.fix: Set `scroll-margin-top` on focusable elements to match the sticky header height so focus scrolls clear of it, and check the z-index stacking. Then gate it: CI test tabs through forms at 1.4x zoom and asserts the focus ring is fully visible.

antipattern.symptom: Compare-table checkbox is 20×20 CSS px; fails 2.5.8.
antipattern.fix: Bump to 24×24 minimum; 44×44 for primary; document exceptions explicitly.

antipattern.symptom: Login flow requires solving a picture captcha; no alternative.
antipattern.root-cause: Author treated captcha as security default.
antipattern.fix: Add passkey / magic link / OAuth alternative path.

antipattern.symptom: A multi-step checkout asks for the same email address at step 1 and again at step 3.
antipattern.root-cause: No state carried between steps, so each step collects its inputs from scratch.
antipattern.fix: Pre-fill from the earlier step, or drop the field entirely. Where the re-entry is a genuine security re-verification, keep it and record the justification in the finding.

antipattern.symptom: A 2.2 delta audit reports conformance on a product that never had a 2.1 AA audit; the report reads clean while the 2.1 floor underneath it is untested.
antipattern.root-cause: The delta framing was applied without its precondition — 2.2 conformance means the whole of 2.1 (minus 4.1.1) plus the 9 new SC.
antipattern.fix: Run the full a11y audit first and establish the 2.1 AA baseline; only then scope this methodology to the delta. Where no baseline exists, the decision tree routes out to full a11y testing rather than producing a partial claim.
